hints: Write identical(a, b) first: both NULL -> yes; one NULL -> no; otherwise equal keys AND identical left AND identical right.
Keys are unique, so only ONE node of BST2 can possibly match: the one holding BST1's root key. Search for it like a normal BST search, then compare.
Identical means the whole subtree, not just a prefix. A matching node with an extra descendant (test 7) is NOT a subtree.
